correctness.rationale: For the explicitly listed 38-edge support, exact rational Gaussian elimination of its 17-by-17 truncated bipartite incidence Gram matrix gives the target absolute row sum 13394263/4220481. The full affine projector has coefficient 256/81 by two-sided centering, leaving exact excess 1497389/113952987. Seven explicit perfect matchings cover every support edge, so their mean is a relative-interior face point. The packaged standard-library Fraction checker verifies all row and column constraints, strict support positivity and strict outside normal-cone slack for two distinct finite inputs with epsilon=1/1000000. These KKT conditions give the asserted projection outputs, hence the lower bound. It is not a claim of an exact global norm or of exhaustive face classification.

value.rationale: The first dimension at which nonnegative bistochastic constraints worsen the maximum-entry stability of the Frobenius projector is a natural structural threshold. An exact, reproducible order-nine violation narrows the previously displayed explicit obstruction from order twelve to order nine, with a positive rational gap. The result has a direct perturbation interpretation: using the full-support Jacobian underestimates worst-case coordinate perturbations already in 9-by-9 doubly stochastic repair. This finite cutoff is not a routine test of an arbitrary slice: a supported face must be shown feasible and its local map realizable by genuine finite projection inputs.
